title: Equity Refresh Discrepancy from Pre-Acquisition Grant Policy
scenario_text:
Context from Rippling (Employee Records):
Employee A: Kai Okafor | Role: Senior Product Manager (L5) | Hire date: Mar 2023 | Origin: Direct hire | Annual equity refresh: 2,400 RSUs (vesting quarterly) | Last refresh: Jan 2026 | Next refresh: Jan 2027
Employee B: Nina Petrova | Role: Senior Product Manager (L5) | Hire date: Nov 2022 | Origin: SpectraLab acquisition (closed Feb 2023) | Annual equity refresh: 3,800 RSUs (vesting monthly) | Last refresh: Jul 2025 | Next refresh: Jul 2026

Pay Equity Audit Flag (Automated, Mar 2026):
'ALERT: Two employees in same role/level/geo with >40% variance in annual equity value. Kai Okafor: $96K/yr equity value. Nina Petrova: $152K/yr equity value. Investigate for potential pay equity concern.'

Confluence — 'Equity Programs' Space (Page: 'Refresh Grant Policy v3.1', last edited Nov 2025):
Section 4.2: 'All employees at L5 receive annual refresh grants of 2,000-3,000 RSUs based on performance rating, vesting quarterly over 1 year. Grants issued in January annually.'
[Page history shows v2.0 existed until Apr 2024 with no mention of acquisition transitions]

Confluence — 'SpectraLab Integration' Space (Page: 'Compensation Transition Plan', last edited Apr 2023):
'Acquired employees retain existing equity schedules for 24-month transition period. Monthly vesting cadence honored. Refresh amounts calculated at 1.2x Meridian standard to account for acceleration clause buyout. Transition ends at individual 24-month anniversary of close.'
[RESOLVED COMMENT by @cfo, Mar 2023]: 'Approved 1.2x multiplier but ONLY for transition period. After 24mo, normalize to standard Meridian refresh policy. Do not auto-extend.'

Slack — #people-ops (Feb 3, 2026, 9:18 AM):
@jasmine.torres: Quick check — do the SpectraLab transition comp arrangements expire based on close date (Feb 2023) or individual start-in-role date?
@devon.xu: Close date. So Feb 2025 for everyone.
@jasmine.torres: Nina Petrova got a refresh in Jul 2025 at the old 1.2x rate. That's 5 months past expiration.
@devon.xu: 😬 Rippling probably auto-calculated based on her profile flag. I don't think anyone manually checked.
@jasmine.torres: Who owns the transition-off? Was it ever assigned?
[No reply in thread]

Google Sheets — 'SpectraLab Transition Tracker' (last modified: Jun 2023):
Column headers: Name | Transition Start | 24mo End Date | Multiplier | Status
Nina Petrova | Feb 2023 | Feb 2025 | 1.2x | 'Active'
[Sheet appears abandoned — no updates since Jun 2023, 'Status' column never changed for any employee]
question: What is the correct resolution for the pay equity audit flag on Okafor vs. Petrova?

contributor.name: Jasmine Torres
contributor.title: Senior Total Rewards Analyst
contributor.domain_expertise: Compensation band management, equity refresh cycles, job leveling frameworks, pay equity audits

choices: No action needed — Petrova's higher equity is explained by the SpectraLab transition policy, which provides a legitimate business justification for the disparity.

Petrova's Jul 2025 refresh was issued in error at the expired 1.2x transition rate; her next refresh (Jul 2026) should normalize to standard L5 range (2,000-3,000 RSUs, quarterly vesting, January cycle), and the overage on the current grant should be documented as a system processing error.
Increase Okafor's refresh to match Petrova's 3,800 RSUs to eliminate the pay equity gap, since both are L5 PMs in the same geo.
Escalate to legal — the transition period has expired and any continued preferential treatment of acquired employees may constitute discriminatory compensation practice.
